fields.name: Elaichi Wali Chai
fields.description: Elaichi Chai is a fragrant Indian tea infused with green cardamom, offering a warm, sweet, and aromatic flavor. It is loved for its soothing aroma and refreshing taste, making it a perfect cup for relaxing mornings and cozy evenings.

fields.name: Ginger Chai
fields.description: Ginger tea is a popular, warming herbal beverage made by infusing fresh or dried ginger root in hot water. Renowned globally for its spicy, invigorating flavor and exceptional health benefits, it has been used for centuries as both a comforting drink and a natural remedy

fields.name: Masala Chai
fields.description: Masala Chai (literally "spiced tea") is a traditional Indian beverage made by brewing strong black tea with milk, water, sugar, and a blend of aromatic spices and herbs. Originated in the Indian subcontinent, it has evolved from an ancient Ayurvedic herbal remedy into one of the most popular global tea beverages.

fields.name: Matcha Tea
fields.description: Experience the rich, vibrant taste of pure Japanese Matcha. Grown in the shade and stone-ground to perfection, this superfood green tea delivers smooth, rich umami flavors alongside jitter-free, sustained energy. Perfect for traditional tea rituals, modern lattes, and daily wellness.

fields.name: Green Tea
fields.description: Green tea is an unfermented tea crafted from the fresh leaves of the Camellia sinensis plant. Unlike black or oolong teas, fresh green tea leaves are steamed or pan-fired immediately after harvesting to prevent oxidation, retaining their vibrant green color, delicate vegetal taste, and high concentration of natural antioxidants.

fields.name: Lemongrass Ginger Tea
fields.description: Lemongrass Ginger is a vibrant, caffeine-free herbal infusion that blends the bright, citrusy notes of fresh lemongrass with the warm, spicy kick of root ginger. It offers a naturally uplifting aroma and a clean, invigorating taste profile that works equally well served steaming hot or poured over ice.

fields.name: Hibiscus Tea
fields.description: Hibiscus Tea (often called Roselle) is a vibrant, ruby-red herbal infusion made from the dried calyces of the Hibiscus sabdariffa flower. Loved globally for its bold color and sharp, refreshing taste, it delivers a flavor profile strikingly similar to tart cranberries or pomegranates.

fields.name: Earl Grey Tea
fields.description: Earl Grey is one of the world’s most recognizable scented black tea blends. It features a base of robust black tea leaves (traditionally Chinese or Indian, like Assam) infused with the cold-pressed oil extracted from the rind of the bergamot orange—a citrus fruit grown primarily in Calabria, Italy.
